description: Falcon Surface is a software platform designed to provide endpoint protection and threat detection for organizations. The software leverages cloud-based analytics to monitor and analyze activity across endpoints, identifying potential vulnerabilities and malicious behavior. Itsfeatures include real-time monitoring, incident response capabilities, and automated remediation processes, aiming to secure devices from a range of cyber threats. Falcon Surface integrates with other security tools to centralize management and reporting, addressing the business problem of preventing unauthorized access and mitigating risks associated with malware and ransomware attacks. The software is positioned to support security teams in managing and reducing the impact of security incidents.
